    (14, 7): [], # L=1, I=2
    (14, 8): [], # L=1, I=3
}

for risk in risks:
    i = risk['impact']
    l = risk['likelihood']
    # Map Impact 1->F(6), 2->G(7), 3->H(8)
    # Map Likelihood 1->14, 2->13, 3->12
    col = 5 + i
    row = 15 - l
